name: Global Switch Singapore Tai Seng
notes: Operator lists Singapore Tai Seng at 2 Tai Seng Avenue with 17MW; assigned to Central Singapore/Tai Seng cluster.

name: Equinix SG4
notes: Operator page gives 7 Tai Seng Drive and 90,847 sq ft; Equinix launch release says first phase 1,400 cabinets and full build over 4,000 cabinets/132,180 sq ft.

name: BDx SIN1 / OneTen Paya Lebar
notes: BDx official location page lists SIN1 with 4,181 sqm gross white space and 9.6MW at/near Paya Lebar; DCD corroborates OneTen Paya Lebar acquisition and capacity.

name: OVHcloud SGP2
notes: OVHcloud announced its second Singapore data centre on 2023-11-07; DCD reports 2MW capacity and notes OVHcloud did not disclose the landlord/location.

name: Nxera DC Kim Chuan 2
notes: Nxera official page identifies DC Kim Chuan 2 as an operating Singapore facility; DCD reports the former Singtel site as 21MW.

name: Keppel DC Singapore 1
notes: Keppel pages place KDC SGP1 at 25 Serangoon North Avenue 5 in Serangoon North Industrial Estate with 225,956 sq ft GFA.

name: NTT Serangoon Data Center
notes: NTT official page lists Serangoon Data Center with 8.6MW critical IT load and 5,000 sqm combined data center server space.

name: Iron Mountain SIN-1 Serangoon
notes: Iron Mountain official page places the Singapore data center in Serangoon with 14,200 sqm/154,000 sq ft; EvoSwitch/Iron Mountain facility page lists 1 Serangoon North Ave 6 and 5MW.

name: Empyrion Digital SG1 Dodid
notes: Operator page lists SG1 Dodid at 71 Tagore Lane with 7.7MW IT capacity and 42,000 sq ft colocation space, near the Serangoon North cluster.

name: Princeton Digital SG1
notes: Aggregate sources place PDG SG1 at 7000 Ang Mo Kio Ave 5 and report 17MW; retained as weaker evidence because current operator page was not surfaced in search snippets.

name: STT Defu Campus / STT Singapore 3
notes: STT official site reports six Singapore data centres and >110MW overall IT load; ITNews/Baxtel identify Defu 3 as 15MW and the Defu campus as 40MW at Defu Avenue 1.

name: Global Switch Singapore Woodlands
notes: Operator lists Woodlands at 7 Woodlands Height with 22MW; Aurecon states the 25,000 sqm facility was officially opened in March 2019.

name: Microsoft Azure Woodlands
notes: Aggregate source places Microsoft Azure Woodlands at 1 Woodlands Industrial Park E9; Microsoft community PDF says Microsoft operates three datacentres in Singapore but does not publish site MW.

name: Microsoft Singapore Woodlands 2 (SG2)
notes: DataCenterMap identifies a second Microsoft Woodlands site at 8-9 Woodlands Industrial Park E9; Microsoft public PDF confirms three Singapore datacentres but omits per-site capacity.

name: 1-Net North Data Centre
notes: Sources identify 1-Net North as a Tier III, purpose-built northern Singapore facility at 18 Riverside Road/Marsiling with about 20,000 sqm; public MW not found.

name: AirTrunk SGP1 Loyang Campus
notes: Operator page lists SGP1 in Loyang with 78+MW total capacity, 20,000 sqm technical data hall area and 18 data halls.

name: Digital Realty SIN11 / Digital Loyang 1
notes: Digital Realty official page lists SIN11 at 3 Loyang Way with 183,000 sq ft; Baxtel reports 13.2MW critical IT capacity.

name: Digital Realty SIN12 / Digital Loyang II
notes: Digital Realty official pages list SIN12 at 11 Loyang Close with 365,000 sq ft; company announcement says the facility provides up to 50MW critical power.

name: STT Loyang / STT Singapore 6
notes: Business Times reports STT GDC officially launched a Loyang Close hyperscale facility with up to 40MW IT load on 2021-07-06.

name: NeutraDC SNG-1 Changi North Way
notes: NeutraDC official page references SNG-1 at Changi North Way as part of east-west redundancy with SNG-3; DCD reports Telin/NeutraDC site at 30 Changi North Way established in 2009.

name: Keppel Floating Data Centre Park / Loyang Offshore Supply Base
notes: Aggregate/industry sources describe a planned modular near-shore floating data centre project at Loyang Offshore Supply Base; capacity not publicly confirmed.

name: Equinix SG1
notes: Operator page lists SG1 at 20 Ayer Rajah Crescent with 109,211 sq ft; assigned to South West due to Ayer Rajah/Queenstown-western cluster.

name: Equinix SG2
notes: Operator page lists SG2 at 15 Pioneer Walk; DataCenterMap notes western Singapore location near SEA-ME-WE cable landing stations.

name: Equinix SG5
notes: Operator page lists SG5 at 6 Sunview Drive; Equinix expansion release says SG5 exceeds 2,950 cabinets/83,000 sq ft after phase expansion, with 5,000 cabinets expected at full buildout.

name: Equinix SG6
notes: Equinix announced SG6, a nine-story Jalan Tukang facility expected to open Q1 2027 with 20MW when fully built; awarded under Singapore DC-CFA.

name: Google Jurong West Data Center Campus
notes: Google official page says it purchased land in Jurong West in 2011; SBR/DCD reported a third Jurong West facility started construction in 2018. Public MW not disclosed.

name: Meta Singapore Data Centre
notes: Meta engineering page describes the Tanjong Kling hyperscale facility; DCD reported the project as 170,000 sqm and 150MW when fully operational.

name: Nxera DC Tuas
notes: Singtel/Nxera and JTC report DC Tuas opened on 2026-02-09 with 58MW AI-ready capacity, raising Nxera Singapore capacity to 120MW.

name: Nxera DC West
notes: Nxera official site lists DC West among Singapore facilities; DCD reports DC West as a 570,000 sq ft, 41MW facility taken over from Singtel.

name: ST Engineering Jalan Boon Lay Data Centre
notes: ST Engineering official release says it broke ground 2024-06-25 on a seven-storey Jalan Boon Lay facility due in 2026; DCD says local reports indicate 7.5MW.

name: DayOne / GDS 21 Jalan Buroh Data Center
notes: DayOne official page says it received a 2023 DC-CFA permit for about 20MW and acquired 21 Jalan Buroh in 2024; DCD reports the warehouse acquisition for data center redevelopment.
